INSERT INTO wx_department (id,corp_id, dept_id, name, name_en, parent_id, `order`, department_leader, sync_version,tenant_id,create_time,update_time) VALUES
(#{item.id},#{item.corpId}, #{item.deptId}, #{item.name}, #{item.nameEn}, #{item.parentId}, #{item.order}, #{item.departmentLeader},#{item.syncVersion},#{item.tenantId},#{item.createTime},#{item.updateTime})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = IF(sync_version <= VALUES(sync_version), VALUES(name), name), name_en = IF(sync_version <= VALUES(sync_version), VALUES(name_en), name_en), parent_id = IF(sync_version <= VALUES(sync_version), VALUES(parent_id), parent_id), `order` = IF(sync_version <= VALUES(sync_version), VALUES(`order`), `order`), department_leader = IF(sync_version <= VALUES(sync_version), CAST(VALUES(department_leader) AS JSON), department_leader), sync_version = IF(sync_version <= VALUES(sync_version), VALUES(sync_version), sync_version), update_time = IF(sync_version <= VALUES(sync_version), VALUES(update_time), update_time)
